name: HiringCafe
tagline: Modern job discovery platform with a filterable public jobs API
description: HiringCafe is a modern job discovery platform that indexes and filters job listings for developers and job seekers. It provides a public API for searching and filtering job postings programmatically, enabling integration into career tools, job boards, and automated discovery workflows.
